## Checklist
- [ ] Every new or changed link is free, official, and opened by me; `python scripts/check_links.py <files>` passes
- [ ] Changing facts (free tiers, prices, numbers) are dated and sourced
- [ ] Lesson ids are unchanged (or the change is noted in CHANGELOG.md)
- [ ] Skills were edited only in `.agents/skills/` and `python scripts/sync_agents.py` was run
- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/check_template.py` passes (no personal progress, notes or keys)
- [ ] For Mentor or agent changes: tested with ______ (agent name)
